ArgumentParseCoverage.description:
How much of a transcript :class:`ArgumentFeatures` attributed, and how much not.

Every Justice turn lands in exactly one of the four counts below
``justice_turns``, checked on construction: the parse states what it could
not read rather than spreading it over the sides.

closing_line.description: Whether the reporter's closing '(Whereupon … submitted.)' line was found. Without it the parse ran to the end of the text, which may then end inside the argument (a head-cut row) or run on into the word index
closing_line.title: Closing Line

justice_turns.description: Every Justice-labelled turn in the text
justice_turns.title: Justice Turns

justice_turns_attributed.description: Turns of a resolved Justice in a segment with a side
justice_turns_attributed.title: Justice Turns Attributed

justice_turns_outside_segments.description: Turns before the first segment header: the Chief Justice calling the case, or every turn of a text where no header was read
justice_turns_outside_segments.title: Justice Turns Outside Segments

justice_turns_unattributed_segment.description: Turns of a resolved Justice in a segment whose side is null
justice_turns_unattributed_segment.title: Justice Turns Unattributed Segment

justice_turns_unresolved.description: Turns inside a segment under a Justice label whose surname the roster does not carry (a misprint, or a Justice outside the roster)
justice_turns_unresolved.title: Justice Turns Unresolved

notes.description: One line for each segment or read worth a reader's eye
notes.title: Notes

unrecognized_label_lines.description: Lines that open like a speaker label (capitals, then a colon) under a title the parse does not read as one; their words are counted with the turn they fall in, so this is how many such lines a reader may want to look at
unrecognized_label_lines.title: Unrecognized Label Lines

unrecognized_labels.description: The distinct label-like prefixes those lines open with, as printed
unrecognized_labels.title: Unrecognized Labels

unresolved_labels.description: The distinct Justice labels the roster did not resolve, as printed
unresolved_labels.title: Unresolved Labels

ArgumentParseCoverage.title: ArgumentParseCoverage

ArgumentSegment.description: One advocate's argument or rebuttal, as its header in the transcript names it.

advocate.description: Turns and words of the advocate the header names: a label whose surname appears in the header

case_number.description: The docket number an 'IN CASE <number>' header names, which is how a consolidated argument marks whose counsel is speaking. Null otherwise
case_number.title: Case Number

header.description: The header as printed, its lines joined by single spaces: the text the side was read from
header.title: Header

justice.description: Turns and words of every Justice in the segment, resolved or not

kind.description: 'rebuttal' for a 'REBUTTAL ARGUMENT OF' header, else 'argument'
kind.title: Kind

other_turns.description: Turns of any other speaker label: counsel the header does not name
other_turns.title: Other Turns

role.description: Whom the advocate appeared for: a party (an appellant read as petitioner, an appellee as respondent), the United States as amicus curiae, or another amicus. Null where the header names none
role.title: Role

side.description: The key this segment's Justice turns are counted under: the role, and for an amicus the position it supported. Null where either is unread, and the segment's Justice turns are then counted unattributed
side.title: Side

supports.description: The position the header says the advocate supported ('supporting the petitioner', 'in support of the judgment below', 'supporting vacatur'); a party header naming none supports its own party. Null for an amicus header naming no support, and wherever role is null; a rebuttal whose header names no side is read as the petitioner's, so its role is never null
supports.title: Supports

ArgumentSegment.title: ArgumentSegment

ArgumentTurnCount.description: Turns and words, one count pair of :class:`ArgumentFeatures`.

turns.description: Speaker turns: one per printed speaker label
turns.title: Turns

words.description: Words spoken in those turns: whitespace-separated tokens carrying a letter or digit, the speaker label and the reporter's parentheticals excluded
words.title: Words

ArgumentTurnCount.title: ArgumentTurnCount

JusticeArgumentFeatures.description: One Justice's questioning, split by the side of the segment each turn fell in.

by_alignment.description: The same turns by the position the segment argued for
by_alignment.title: By Alignment

by_side.description: Attributed turns by segment side; a side the Justice never spoke in is absent
by_side.title: By Side

justice.description: The roster surname the label resolved to, e.g. 'Kagan'
justice.title: Justice

total.description: Every attributed turn: the sum over by_side, and over by_alignment

unattributed.description: Turns in segments whose side is unread. Never folded into a side

JusticeArgumentFeatures.title: JusticeArgumentFeatures

description:
Per-Justice questioning by side, read from one cleaned argument transcript.

Computed by :func:`fedcourtsai.pipeline.argument_features.parse_argument_features`
from the text :func:`fedcourtsai.pipeline.documents.extract_transcript_text`
stores, deterministically and with no model in the loop, so one transcript
always yields one count. ``assignment`` states the reading that turns a
speaker label into a side. The totals are checked on construction against
the rows and the coverage against the segments.

alignment_totals.description: The same turns summed by the position the segment argued for
alignment_totals.title: Alignment Totals

assignment.description: How a speaker turn was assigned to a side, in one line
assignment.title: Assignment

coverage.description: What was and was not attributed

justices.description: One row per resolved Justice who spoke, by surname
justices.title: Justices

parser_version.description: The parse rules' version; a change to what a given text yields moves it
parser_version.title: Parser Version

side_totals.description: Every resolved Justice's attributed turns, summed by segment side
side_totals.title: Side Totals

title: ArgumentFeatures
